metadata.name: win
metadata.description: (key, title, content [, x] [, y]) - make a draggable/resizable window in ONE step. Compose two with doc: =doc(win("w1","A","hi",60,60), win("w2","B","yo",440,180))

metadata.name: window
metadata.description: (key, x, y, w, h, title, content) - a draggable/resizable window FRAME around content. Geometry (x/y/w/h) comes from the host's key.x/.y/.w/.h cels, so it's reactive + persists. Titlebar drags; corner resizes; body scrolls.

metadata.name: win.drag
metadata.description: the active drag/resize gesture {key,ox,oy,resize?} or null — module of the window manager's state, kept as a cel so it's reactive + dehydrates

metadata.name: win.grab
metadata.description: pointerdown handler (dispatch): start dragging window <key>; records the mouse->origin offset + captures the pointer

metadata.name: win.move
metadata.description: pointermove handler (dispatch): while dragging, setValue the window's x/y to track the pointer

metadata.name: win.grabResize
metadata.description: pointerdown handler (dispatch): start resizing window <key> from the corner handle

metadata.name: win.resizeMove
metadata.description: pointermove handler (dispatch): while resizing, setValue the window's w/h (min 120x80)

metadata.name: win.drop
metadata.description: pointerup handler (dispatch): end the drag/resize gesture (clears win.drag)

metadata.name: win.raise
metadata.description: pointerdown handler (dispatch): raise window <key> to the top of the z-order (bumps the reactive key.z cel)

metadata.name: win.list
metadata.description: the open-window registry (array of keys) — winopen/winclose maintain it; wintoolbar renders from it

metadata.name: winopen
metadata.description: (key, title) - register a window: add to win.list + seed its geometry cels (x/y/w/h/z/min/title) + raise

metadata.name: winclose
metadata.description: (key) - remove a window from win.list

metadata.name: win.minimize
metadata.description: (key) - minimize: set key.min=1 (the window hides; its chip stays in the toolbar)

metadata.name: win.restore
metadata.description: (key) - restore a minimized window (key.min=0) + raise it

metadata.name: wintoolbar
metadata.description: (keys, titles) - a taskbar of open windows; click a chip to restore+raise. Pass win.list + the titles.

metadata.name: win.stop
metadata.description: pointerdown handler (dispatch): stop a titlebar button press from starting a window drag

metadata.name: winmake
metadata.description: (id, title, content) - the formula: create a window backed by a STATE cel (win.<id>) + its frame. Modify the state cel to open/close/move. =winmake("d1","Window 1","hi")

metadata.name: winframe
metadata.description: (state, content) - render a window frame DOWNSTREAM of a state cel; its buttons write the state cel by ref

metadata.name: winx.grab
metadata.description: titlebar drag (state-cel windows)

metadata.name: winx.move
metadata.description: drag move

metadata.name: winx.grabResize
metadata.description: start resize

metadata.name: winx.resizeMove
metadata.description: resize

metadata.name: winx.drop
metadata.description: end drag/resize

metadata.name: winx.raise
metadata.description: raise z

metadata.name: winx.min
metadata.description: toggle minimize in the state cel

metadata.name: winx.max
metadata.description: toggle maximize in the state cel

metadata.name: winx.close
metadata.description: set the window state cel to closed

metadata.name: winx.stop
metadata.description: stop a button press starting a drag

metadata.name: winx.drag
metadata.description: transient drag state for state-cel windows

metadata.name: win.active
metadata.description: focus pointer for the LOCAL keyboard key stream: the ref of the window keystrokes route to. One pointer per stream (network/gamepad get their own).

metadata.name: win.topz
metadata.description: shared z-order fountain for BOTH window kinds — worksheet (winsheet.*) and state-cel (winx.*) raise/max/restore handlers bump this and use the new value, so clicking ANY window raises it above ALL others.

metadata.name: winapp
metadata.description: (id, title, contentSource) — create a window backed by a state cel whose content is a FORMULA (win.<id>.content). Mounts a real app: =winapp("wallet","Wallet","(domWallet (locked walletNote) (apiKeys))")

metadata.name: chatui
metadata.description: (channel, log, input) — generic chat UI; the other party (claude/grok/peer) is just a user

metadata.name: chat.send
metadata.description: send the chat input; appends your line then the LLM reply (or broadcasts to a peer)

metadata.name: chat.key
metadata.description: Enter in the chat input sends

metadata.name: chatapp
metadata.description: (channel, title) — a chat WINDOW: seeds log/input + a winframe of (chat …). =chatapp("claude","Claude")

metadata.name: desktop
metadata.description: mount a fixed full-screen wallpaper behind the windows (ships inline). =desktop()

metadata.name: readme
metadata.description: the plastron readme as a vnode, for a readme window

metadata.name: readmewin
metadata.description: genesis: the readme WINDOW with the full plastron README

metadata.name: winx.show
metadata.description: show + focus a state-cel window (un-close, un-minimize, raise) — taskbar restore

metadata.name: chat.run
metadata.description: (ch, commands) — apply an agent command stream to a chat under withAccessor(chat segment); Layer 1 confines every write to that segment

metadata.name: windows.wallpaper
metadata.description: the shipped default wallpaper (a data-URI; locked library data, never rides user archives). desktop.bg falls through to it when desktop.wallpaper is empty - set desktop.wallpaper to an OPFS path (e.g. an uploaded image) to re-skin.
